function.description: Returns the activity with the given ID
function.name: api_getActivityByID

id.description: The id of the activity to retrieve

description.description: The description provided when creating the activity

endTime.description: The time at which the activity ended

originatingWorkItemActivityId.description: The id of the activity of type WORK_ITEM whose deployment created this TASK activity. a preview activity is of type WORK_ITEM. if the preview is deployed then a new activity of type TASK is created for deploying the preview and the originatingWorkItemActivityId is set to the preview activity id.

recurring.description: Denotes whether an activity is recurring or not

startTime.description: The time at which the activity started

type.description:
Type of activity:
  * 'WORK_ITEM' - activity that requires user action when the status is READY or FAILED
  * 'TASK' - activity that is not of type WORK_ITEM
